feedback.end: The Middle Ages was a period of time in Europe that began in the year 500 and lasted until the year 1500.

feedback.end: The first school in England was set up inside a church in the year 547. In the Middle Ages, education was controlled by the Church.

instruction.text: This is a classroom inside a church in the Middle Ages. What do you think was taught in this classroom?

feedback.end: As the Church controlled education, pupils were mainly taught about Christianity. They learnt how to live according to Christian teachings and studied religious texts.

instruction.text: What language is this religious text written in?

feedback.end: Religious texts like the Bible were not written in English, so pupils had to learn Latin to read them.
